decision.explanation: The sources explicitly state three distinct start dates for the 'Freaky Friday' musical at different venues: October 4, 2016 (Signature Theatre, Arlington, Virginia) per D1S1; January 31, 2017 (La Jolla Playhouse, San Diego) per D1S5/D2S5; and January 1, 2018 (Signature Theatre, Arlington, Virginia) per D2S1. These represent separate performance runs or conflicting reports of the same run, all validly answering 'when' the musical began performances in specific contexts. The slot hint 'other' allows for these multiple valid temporal referents.
